artifact.text:
Issue #30 — "Peer-range bump to admit bareguard 0.13.x (conditional — only if bareguard 0.13.0 ships)"

PRIORITY: None set. GitHub shows no priority field — no assignees ("No one assigned"), no milestone ("No milestone"), no projects ("No projects"), no relationships ("None yet"). The only label is "dependencies" (Pull requests that update a dependency file). The issue's own status heading is "BLOCKED / conditional — no action until bareguard 0.13.0 is approved & released", i.e. it was a conditional tracking item, not a scheduled priority.

WHAT IS BROKEN:
- bare-agent 0.36.0 pins the optional peer bareguard to ">=0.9.0 <0.13.0". With that <0.13.0 ceiling, bare-agent 0.36.0 would refuse to install alongside bareguard 0.13.x — an install-time peer-range conflict, even though the adapter is already compliant.
- Root cause of the incoming 0.13.0: the bareguard maintainer proposed (not yet approved at filing time) bareguard 0.13.0 hardening the gate.annotate array fail-open — `surface` must be an explicit boolean, else the row is malformed → buffer nothing, never throw, emit a distinct annotate_malformed audit row. That is a gate-behaviour + audit-format change, cut as a minor pre-1.0.
- No code fault on the bare-agent side: judgeToAnnotation (src/bareguard-adapter.js) returns a single object literal and always sets `surface: v.verdict !== 'honored'` (an explicit boolean), so it satisfies the new rule by construction. The fix is a manifest range bump only — no code change.

RESOLUTION (activity): hamr0 commented Aug 13 — resolved in v0.36.1 (published to npm, latest). bareguard 0.13.0 went live; peer + dev ranges widened to >=0.9.0 <0.14.0 (conservative <0.14.0 ceiling). No code change; judgeToAnnotation already compliant (single object literal, explicit-boolean surface, String()-coerced JSON-safe meta). Validated against bareguard 0.13.0: bareguard-touching tests 84/84, CI full suite green. PR #31, tag v0.36.1. Issue closed as completed on Aug 13.
